description: This source file defines Pydantic models for event data source configurations, event metadata, and event timelines, along with MongoDB helper classes for CRUD operations on corresponding collections. It is part of a backend system managing event-related data.

classes.name: EventDataSourceModel
classes.description: Pydantic model capturing configuration details for an event data source.

classes.name: EventMetadataModel
classes.description: Pydantic model representing core metadata for an event, including start/end times and status.

classes.name: EventTimelineModel
classes.description: Pydantic model for event timelines, capturing intervals and actions associated with events.

classes.name: MongoCollectionHelper
classes.description: Generic helper class providing CRUD operations for MongoDB collections.

classes.name: EventDataSourceHelper
classes.description: Specialized helper inheriting CRUD methods for the event_data_source collection.

classes.name: EventMetadataHelper
classes.description: Specialized helper inheriting CRUD methods for the event_metadata collection.

classes.name: EventTimelineHelper
classes.description: Specialized helper inheriting CRUD methods for the event_timelines collection.

methods.description: Delete a document matching the query.
